files.description: Angular SPA shell HTML for the EHI export documentation site. Content is rendered client-side from the JS bundle.
Compiled Angular bundle containing the complete EHI export data dictionary (resourceList and ehiexportdocs arrays with 27 resource types and 777 field definitions).
Full-page screenshot of the EHI export documentation landing page showing all export categories (CCDA, CSV, PDF, Word, Image).
Full-page screenshot of the Demographic CSV entity detail page showing all 105 field definitions as an example of the data dictionary detail view.
Mandatory disclosures and costs document (7 pages). Lists certification criteria including (b)(10) but contains no EHI export technical details.
Raw extraction of the ehiexportdocs array from the JS bundle — 777 field definitions with id, module, field, type, and description.
Raw extraction of the resourceList array from the JS bundle — 27 CSV export resource types with id, module name, and description.
Bun TypeScript enrichment script that parses the Angular JS bundle and extracts the structured data dictionary into queryable JSON.
Complete structured data dictionary: 32 entities (27 resource types + 5 sub-entities), 777 fields, plus 4 non-CSV export format categories with 19 document types.
Flat list of 27 CSV export resource types with IDs and descriptions.
Extraction accounting: totals, module coverage, field counts, parse failures (none).
Enrichment documentation: run commands, input boundary, output descriptions, known limitations.
